item.title: AI stethoscope beats GPs at detecting heart valve disease
item.description: Researchers in the UK have developed a machine learning model that pairs with an electronic stethoscope to detect the hard-to-diagnose condition. The post AI stethoscope beats GPs at detecting heart valve disease appeared first on Medical Republic.

item.title: Dogs halve childhood asthma risk
item.description: High-level exposure throughout the first year of life had the greatest protective effect, with those genetically predisposed to poorer lung function benefiting the most. The post Dogs halve childhood asthma risk appeared first on Medical Republic.

item.title: More fake GLP-1 weight loss drugs trigger TGA alert
item.description: Tests find some imported products contain no active ingredient at all. See the list. The post More fake GLP-1 weight loss drugs trigger TGA alert appeared first on Medical Republic.

item.title: IL-18 blockade hits primary endpoint in AD
item.description: Upstream cytokine inhibition shows statistically significant efficacy and clean safety through 12 weeks in a phase 2a trial. The post IL-18 blockade hits primary endpoint in AD appeared first on Medical Republic.

item.title: When to consider oral appliance therapy for snoring and OSA
item.description: A practical guide to assessment, patient selection and management in general practice. The post When to consider oral appliance therapy for snoring and OSA appeared first on Medical Republic.

item.title: Coming up: the role of GLP-1 in the management of CKD in T2D
item.description: New evidence and accessible and effective medications have seen a push for GPs to be more proactive when it comes to detecting and treating early chronic kidney disease. The post Coming up: the role of GLP-1 in the management of CKD in T2D appeared first on Medical Republic.

item.title: Going beyond the ‘bikini line’ in women’s health
item.description: Researchers warn that women’s health doesn’t start and end with sexual and reproductive medicine. The post Going beyond the ‘bikini line’ in women’s health appeared first on Medical Republic.

item.title: Chronic fatigue over chronic fatigue reform
item.description: A parliament hearing has heard from ME/CFS advocates on where and how healthcare needs to step up to address the under-recognised field. The post Chronic fatigue over chronic fatigue reform appeared first on Medical Republic.

item.title: Why are some GPs more likely to burn out?
item.description: Burnout is a late-stage reaction to chronic stress, an Australian researcher says. The post Why are some GPs more likely to burn out? appeared first on Medical Republic.

item.title: More test results available sooner in My Health Record
item.description: Limb x-ray reports are now visible to patients as soon as they’re uploaded, with other imaging results appearing after a shorter, five-day delay. The post More test results available sooner in My Health Record appeared first on Medical Republic.
